The solubility of alkali metal salts in water is due to the fact that the cations get hydrated by water molecules.
What is the relative degree of hydration?

solution.text:
As hydration energy ∝ charge on cation ∝1size of cation
As on moving down size of ion increases so degree of hydration decreases hence the correct order is
Liaq+>Naaq+>Kaq+>Rbaq+>Csaq+
